Write the Grand Finale — show_gameover()

Show the final results, check for a new high score, and save it

What we're doing: When all 8 rounds are finished, this function shows the final results and checks if the player beat the high score. It also saves the high score so it survives power-off — but we'll set up the full saving system in Step 7!

🧩 Analogy This is the award ceremony at the end of a tournament. It announces your score, checks if you broke a record, and updates the hall of fame.

Create the Function

  1. Drag a define show_gameover() block. No parameters.

Inside the function:

a) Show the Final Score

  1. Set final_score_label text to "Your Score: " + score + "/8" (use nested Text → [] + [] and for score)

b) Check for a New High Score

  1. From Logic, drag an if condition do block
  2. Condition: Math → > — score > high_score
    if score > high_score do
  3. Inside:
    • set high_score to score
    • nvs set integer "high_score" high_score
⚠️ What's this NVS block? You're saving the high score to permanent memory! We'll set up the full NVS system in Step 7 — for now, just add the nvs set integer key value block as shown. The other half (reading the saved score on startup) comes in Step 7.

c) Update the Best Score Display

  1. Set best_score_label text to "Best Score: " + high_score + "/8" (use nested Text → [] + [])

d) Show the Game-Over Screen

  1. From M5UI, drag gameover_page screen_load
✅ What you should see: Your define show_gameover() function updates the score labels, checks if you beat the high score (and saves it via NVS), then loads the game-over page. The award ceremony is ready!
💾 Save your progress! All three functions are done! Next we'll wire up the buttons to make everything click.
📋 Complete Function — Here's What show_gameover() Should Look Like

When you're done, your function should look like this:

define show_gameover()
Set final_score_label text to → ["Your Score: " + score + "/8"]
if score > high_score do
set high_score to score
nvs set integer "high_score" high_score
Set best_score_label text to → ["Best Score: " + high_score + "/8"]
gameover_page screen_load
